Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE extraordinary polished scenic key art for OUR WORLD, a cozy private app where real friends inhabit a living ambient world while chatting, remembering and listening to music. This is an aspirational STATIC CONCEPT, not a screenshot of an actual engine. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. FULL BLEED IMMERSIVE SCENE, no title, no text, no logo, no borders, no UI, no diagram, no arrows, no collage. The camera is physically INSIDE a sheltered comfortable spot at SEATED HUMAN EYE LEVEL, about 28-40mm equivalent. Never top-down, isometric, dollhouse, room cutaway, overhead game camera or detached miniature. Strong large foreground forms frame the picture; middle-ground people and activity locations are legible; atmospheric distance opens beyond. Viewers should feel they can settle here and gaze for a long time. Rich dimensional lighting and clear cast/contact shadows, restrained highlights, NOT uniform orange haze or incessant sparkles. There are EXACTLY TWO attractive but grounded ADULT HUMAN USER AVATARS, who are NOT NPC girlfriends/boyfriends. Both are quietly absorbed in their own different purposeful activities, with believable hands, gaze and poses. NO eye contact between the two, no flirting, no coordinated romance pose, no looking at the viewer, no posed portraits, no shared touching, no gaming joystick. The setting rather than the faces is the main attraction, yet the nearer person is large enough to read the current action, about 30-40 percent image height. Clothes are comfortable modest everyday clothes. No children, uniforms, sexualization, mascots, existing IP. The picture should suggest a world with independent natural rhythms and purposeful individual routines. Avoid generic lofi image of two people sitting side-by-side holding mugs. Prioritize deep inviting composition, large readable subjects, visual stillness punctuated by things that can naturally move.
Scene: a sheltered timber seaside veranda opening directly onto a quiet sandy cove. VIEW FROM UNDER THE VERANDA ROOF, foreground a softly moving cream linen curtain at extreme left, low wooden railing right, warm sunlit floor and near tide-washed rocks create depth. The open sea occupies the center and most of the right half, big beautifully shaped translucent turquoise waves rolling onto near sand, curving white foam and shallow reflections, not storm surf. Soft late-afternoon peach sun and azure sky, amber wood under shelter, calm cool ocean. One adult man with short dark hair and loose oatmeal shirt is seated in a large lounge chair at foreground LEFT, reading a book with a hand resting ready to turn a page; a tiny side table holds headphones and a glass. The second adult, woman with shoulder-length dark hair in muted blue summer layers, is strolling barefoot along the near wet shoreline in the middle RIGHT, visible at about 22 percent image height, body side view facing along beach, not approaching the man. Clear safe foot contact and shore path, room for her to pause at a shell and return. One small shorebird at waterline and a distant pair of seabirds, keep sparse. Main visual attraction is the repeating curl of surf and sheltered feeling. Style: beautiful mature anime background / hand-painted cinematic illustration with tangible warm wood, clear water depth, painterly edges, clean legible adult character drawing integrated into lighting. Not photoreal 3D skin. Lighting draws wave crests, cast shadows on veranda, translucent curtain and dappled reflected water under canopy. It feels like you are quietly sharing a holiday afternoon while doing separate things.

Scene: inside a lush but spacious old botanical conservatory at late morning, a quiet observation nook beside a small lily pond. A low seated camera from a woven lounge chair UNDER LARGE NEAR LEAVES frames enormous luminous green leaves at left/top, three receding glass-and-iron greenhouse arches, the pond across the lower middle, a winding stone path from right foreground into depth, warm patterned sunbeams and coherent leaf shadows. Moss green, amber sunlight, airy cream, teal water, small lilac flowers. EXACTLY TWO adult user avatars doing INDEPENDENT activities: nearer right-side adult woman with loose dark bob and sage overshirt leaning over a waist-high potting bench, gently checking a plant with one hand and holding a small watering can in the other, clear readable arms, person about 34 percent image height; the man farther LEFT under leaves sits in a wicker chair sketching a leaf in a notebook, still at least 24 percent image height. Their backs/three-quarter profiles turned toward their own work, NOT toward each other. THREE butterflies maximum: one rested on a bright blossom near camera center-left, one gliding toward pond, one deeper in light, not a cloud of particles. Small visible ripples and one subtle orange fish under clear pond surface, leaves with convincingly different mass. A folded blanket, comfortable chair and cup establish refuge; uncluttered quiet space between them. Style: exceptionally beautiful fixed-camera stylized 3D / soft-toon scenic render with sculptural foliage and dimensional adult characters, handmade texture and soft natural volumetric atmosphere; spatially immersive at human height, never diorama. NO photoreal individual hair/fabric pores, no glass caustic spectacle, no all-over bloom. This image proves 3D can be experienced from a cozy close viewpoint; do not print that sentence. Let plant, water, insect and human behavior all have clear visible places to happen.

Scene: a warmly lit vintage night-train lounge moving through a rainy lakeside landscape at blue hour. Fixed SEATED passenger camera from inside one intimate carriage booth; foreground worn walnut table edge, cup steam and a softly glowing green-shaded reading lamp; a large panoramic window dominates center-left showing streaked raindrops in two scales, wet passing trees, blue lake and tiny distant town lights. No motion blur obscuring interior or people. Viewpoint stays still and protected while outside scenery can slowly drift. Two adult avatars in different seats doing independent things: foreground RIGHT woman with short brown hair and cream sweater wearing over-ear headphones, comfortably reclined in a moss upholstered seat, looking outward/downward, one relaxed hand tapping a notebook, figure 35-40 percent scene height; farther LEFT across aisle a man in muted rust cardigan reads in his own booth with a paperback and visible lowered head, 25 percent image height. No interaction, no looking at each other, no facing audience. Distinct intimate pools of warm amber lamp light separated by cool window light, wood grain and cloth simplified but tactile, rain reflection on window edge, believable seat contact shadows. The long window is not a wall of neon cyberpunk. One sleeping cat on a luggage blanket in the near lower-left corner, subtle curled shape, not center focus; other living motion is cup steam, quiet body shifts and passing scenery. Style: refined hand-painted cinematic anime scenic art with dimensional 2.5D staging, natural adult faces not portrait glamour. A tiny station platform may be distant out the window to imply occasional slow events without turning it into a travel game. The mood is deep shelter, unhurried travel, companionable solitude. Interior not dense with clutter; enough calm window region for a future unobtrusive music pill.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished landscape product-and-behavior concept board, about 1536x1024, for OUR WORLD, a cozy private shared-scene app. Input image is a REFERENCE for EXACT room/people/lighting identity; create new compositions and new poses in this same greenhouse, not modify the original file. Preserve the lush low-eye-level botanical conservatory, pond, near leaves, woman with dark bob/sage overshirt gardening at right, seated dark-haired man sketching at left. They continue independent activities, never stare at each other or audience. No romance poses. The purpose is to show a quiet world can keep living while the user chats, and to storyboard meaningful independent activities. This is a STATIC DESIGN BOARD, not actual UI or animation.
LAYOUT: clean warm-gray presentation background, a small heading "OUR WORLD / A LIVING AFTERNOON". TOP LEFT 74% width: desktop webpage/client in a very restrained smoked-neutral window frame, greenhouse scene almost full bleed with BOTH people and pond still readable, small edge navigation labels "Scene  Chat  Memories  Music", ONE slim bottom music strip "Greenhouse afternoon" with a play icon. No big text over artwork, no piles of cards, no desktop notification. TOP RIGHT 26% width: tall mobile app mockup, top 46% a purpose-composed CLOSE scene of the gardener and near butterflies with pond/leaf framing; do NOT squeeze entire landscape; below, readable OPAQUE ivory chat panel labeled "Chat" with 2 plausible messages "I left you a little recording." and "I'll listen while drawing.", composer "Say something...", a small music row. Top of phone subtle two member avatars means the other person still exists beyond this crop; don't claim to show the full room. Text is concise, no marketing slogans beyond heading.
BOTTOM STRIP: THREE equally sized storyboard panels of the SAME woman, same clothes, SAME potting bench and pot, same camera angle and scale. Captions EXACTLY "OBSERVE", "WATER", "REST". Panel1: watering can rests visibly on bench, she gently checks a leaf. Panel2: she picks up and TILTS the watering can toward pot, clear small stream actually waters SOIL. Panel3: can put back on bench, she lowers hands and watches a butterfly settle on a neighboring flower. These are distinct poses with meaningful object continuity, not three repeated stills. Man remains sketching quietly in distant background when visible. Do not draw arrows, timelines, durations or performance charts.
Beautiful rich but calm scenic light, legible UI, real hands and supported bodies, consistent plants. No coins, chores, red notification badges, quests, scores, fake success toast, progress stats, CTA marketing, console controllers, mini-map, top-down camera. Typography comfortable, restrained rounded corners; this is atmospheric companionship with normal readable UI. Avoid needless decoration and all over bloom.
